Ce plugin doit être approuvé par NeoDex: This plugin must be approved by NeoDex to open.
Clique une pièce sur la ligne ou la colo: Click a piece on the row or column of the hole to drag it, or use the arrows. Your image is kept in the backup.
Le jeu de pièces à faire glisser, de 3 ×: The sliding tile game, from 3 × 3 to 8 × 8: put numbers, your NeoDex wallpaper or your own picture back in order, with the mouse (a whole row slides in one click) or the arrow keys. Grids that can always be solved, the model shown while you hold a button, optional numbers on the picture; a moves and time record for each size.
Records de coups et de temps, et ton ima: Moves and time records, and your picture.
